title: Creation: In the Beginning
claim_policy: Every biblical claim must be traceable to the listed Scripture.

visual_policy.rule: Show creation events described in the passage. Do not invent biblical character appearance details that Scripture does not provide.

script.hook: Before Adam. Before Noah. Before Abraham. The Bible starts with this: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
script.intro: So what happened at the beginning?
body: Genesis 1 says the earth was formless and empty, darkness covered the deep, and the Spirit of God was over the waters.
Then God spoke, and light appeared. God separated the light from the darkness.
He made the sky, gathered the waters, brought forth dry land and vegetation, made the sun, moon, and stars, filled the waters with living creatures, and filled the sky with birds.
Then God created the land animals and humanity in His image, male and female.
Genesis 1:31 says that God saw everything He had made, and it was very good.
script.cta: Follow Kindled Iron. Next, we meet Adam.
